linkHint.vehicle: A cost or payment on a vehicle

noResults.title: No outstanding debt matches these filters

page.title: Revenue overview
page.subtitle: Whether this period made money, how much cash you are holding, and which vehicles earn it.

forbidden.title: No permission to view financial figures
forbidden.description: You need the permission below to open this page. Ask the shop owner to grant it.

business.title: Business result
business.marginUnknown: No revenue yet to compute a margin
business.unassigned: Of which {value} is not tied to a vehicle
business.note: Deposits are excluded from both sides. This is cash profit from the ledger — before depreciation, loan interest or vehicle lease payments.

cash.title: Cash flow
cash.note: Includes deposits taken and refunded — this is the money that actually changed hands this period.

now.title: Right now
now.note: These two figures do not depend on the selected period.

chart.title: Income · costs · profit over time
chart.description: Bars are revenue and costs, the line is profit. Deposits excluded.
chart.empty: No income or costs in this period
chart.emptyHint: Record a voucher in the ledger or take payment on a booking and the figures will show up here.

categories.error: Could not load the category breakdown
categories.emptyHint: Pick another period, or record more vouchers in the ledger.

vehicles.title: Performance by vehicle
vehicles.cardLine: In {revenue} · Out {cost} · {trips, plural, one {# trip} other {# trips}}
vehicles.unassigned: Shared costs not tied to a vehicle: {value}. This is not included in any row above.
vehicles.error: Could not load performance by vehicle
vehicles.empty: No vehicle activity in this period
vehicles.emptyHint: Vehicles with a trip or a voucher in this period will appear here.

customers.title: Revenue by customer
customers.cardLine: {trips, plural, one {# trip} other {# trips}} · {share} of period revenue
customers.unassigned: Not tied to a customer: {value}. Manual vouchers with no linked booking do not belong to any row above.
customers.error: Could not load revenue by customer
customers.empty: No customer activity in this period
customers.emptyHint: Customers with a trip or a payment in this period will appear here.

note.vehicle: Summed from approved vouchers, deposits excluded. Before depreciation, loan interest or vehicle lease payments.
note.customer: Summed from money ACTUALLY received in the period — different from "Total rental value" at the top of the profile, which counts agreed booking value.

entity.marginUnknown: No revenue yet to compute a margin
entity.chartEmptyHint: Pick another period, or record a voucher in the ledger.
